propositions: Gate runs do not warn when the running build is behind the pinned base ref commit, allowing stale code to review new material without detection
When a gate's running build predates the base ref, it may not recognize current config keys, silently ignoring operator settings with misleading 'typo' warnings
The drift check must be added to resolve_gate_handle to compare the running build's commit against the pinned sha in the target repository
Unknown config keys should emit different warning text when drift is detected, replacing 'typo?' with guidance that the build may predate the key
The drift warning must be advisory only: never failing runs, altering verdicts, or changing signatures or provenance
Drift detection must stay silent when build provenance is unavailable, the build sha is absent from the target repo, or the build is at or ahead of the pinned sha
